lines.asr: Where a branch meets a header, there is one curve. Get it wrong and the steel won't fit.
Nexus fabric takes the dimensions of the joint and calculates both flat patterns.
One equation gives every point on the cut.
Then it checks its own work. Both patterns are folded back and must meet on the same curve.
What it cannot confirm, it shows you and the result stays, review required.
Every step is recorded and the whole calculation can be replayed.
The DXF is written, read back, and compared, then marked, not released.
Reading the drawing for you is planned. The calculation, the checks, and the record run today.
